ابتدعن (form VIII)
# اِبْتَدَعْنَ (ibtadaʕna) /ib.ta.daʕ.na/: third-person feminine plural past active of اِبْتَدَعَ (ibtadaʕa)
# اُبْتُدِعْنَ (ubtudiʕna) /ub.tu.diʕ.na/: third-person feminine plural past passive of اِبْتَدَعَ (ibtadaʕa)
# اِبْتَدِعْنَ (ibtadiʕna) /ib.ta.diʕ.na/: second-person feminine plural imperative of اِبْتَدَعَ (ibtadaʕa)
